## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 20-fascicle text by [日稱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%97%A5%E7%A8%B1) Rìchēng and his Sòng imperial-bureau team is the *Pitāputra-samāgama-sūtra* — the Mahāyāna sūtra on the Buddha's reunion with his father King Śuddhodana. The text was incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* tradition and also circulated independently.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to [日稱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%97%A5%E7%A8%B1) Rìchēng's mid-11th-century Sòng-bureau activity, c. 1058 – 1078 CE. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The work is one of the substantial Northern-Sòng Mahāyāna translation projects.

The Taishō text (T0320) is established on the standard apparatus, including the *Shīgǔ* 獅谷 witness.
